name: 79118 · Amarillo, TX
findings: ZIP 79118 (Amarillo) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79118 (Amarillo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
